gpu_fixture: Native D3D12 WARP: all 144 coordinate-coded texels exact; no sample before fence completion; 300-frame limit passed.
filtered_draw_fixture: Two accepted draws and one excluded draw: exact deltas, only two emitted markers, no excluded-draw misattribution; frame limit passed.
measurement: 144 isolated final swap-source texels per frame as numeric CSV, before presentation gamma/FXAA. No screenshot/image output. Sparse samples may miss a small artifact.
limits: 300 frame IDs or 15 seconds; 8 asynchronous readback slots; busy slots logged, never waited on; game stays open.
